Adoption: Includes the placement of a child (as defined in clause 62.2 (Parental Leave)) by permanent care order and includes kinship care where it is comparable to adoption, having regard for all the circumstances.
Agreement: The Health and Allied Services, Managers and Administrative Workers (Victorian Public Sector) (Single Interest Employers) Enterprise Agreement 2025-2027.
AIC: Agreement Implementation Committee — continuing or established under clause 74.10.
Base rate of pay: The rate of pay payable to an Employee in accordance with Schedule 2B and Schedule 3B for their ordinary hours of work, but not including any incentive-based payments and bonuses, loadings, allowances, overtime, penalty rates or any other separately identifiable amounts.
Commission: The Fair Work Commission or any successor body.
Dental Assistant: An Employee classified in accordance with Part 2 of Schedule 2D of this Agreement, and paid pursuant to Part 2 of Schedule 2B.
Department Head: A person responsible for a department or section of the hospital or health service covered by this Agreement.
Department: Refers to Employees within a department who are covered by this Agreement.
Designated Work Group: A group of Employees within a workplace that are entitled to elect an HSR in accordance with the OHS Act.
Employee: A person employed by an Employer listed in Schedule 1A of this Agreement who is employed in any of the classifications set out in this Agreement, other than employees employed solely or predominantly in the provision of public mental health services, or Employees employed pursuant to Health Executive Employment and Remuneration Policy.
Employer: Each organisation listed in Schedule 1A of this Agreement.
Employer Organisation: An organisation of Employers, which would specifically include the VHIA.
FFPPOA: First full pay period on or after.
Health and Allied Services Employee: An Employee classified in accordance with Part 1 of Schedule 2D of this Agreement, and paid pursuant to Part 1 of Schedule 2B.
HSR: An Employee elected to the position of Occupational Health and Safety Representative of a Designated Work Group in accordance with the OHS Act.
HWU Delegate: Has the same meaning as HWU Representative or Job Representative.
HWU: Health Services Union acting through the Victoria No 1 Branch, trading as the "Health Workers Union".
Immediate Family: A spouse (including a former spouse, a de facto partner and a former de facto partner) of the Employee; and a child or adult child (including an adopted child, a step child, a current foster child of the Employee or an ex-nuptial child), parent, grandparent, grandchild or sibling of the Employee or of the Employee's spouse.
Manager and Administrative Worker: An Employee classified in accordance with Part 1 of Schedule 3D or Part 2 of Schedule 3D of this Agreement.
Medical certificate: A certificate from a medical practitioner.
Medical practitioner: A person registered as a medical practitioner by the Medical Board of Australia.
Modern Award: The Health Professionals and Support Services Award 2020.
NES: National Employment Standards — Part 2-2 of the Fair Work Act 2009.
not employed by Royal Women's Hospital o: Means classified under Part 1 of Schedule 3D.
OHS Act: Occupational Health and Safety Act 2004 (Vic), as varied from time to time, or any successor to that Act.
Party: The Employer, Employees and the HWU who are covered by this Agreement.
School age: In relation to a child, the age at which the child is required by law to attend school.
WIRC Act: Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013 (Vic), or where applicable the Accident Compensation Act 1985 (Vic) or the Workers Compensation Act 1958 (Vic).
